entries.description: A two-woman land holding on 9 wooded acres with one permanent structure and electricity, offering camping space. Their purpose is healing and unity consciousness. They welcome girl and boy children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: created by, all the women who come here. Our purpose is to heal, to open the path for transforming ourselves and the world, and to establish unity consciousness on the Planet. We welcome: girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on a leash. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 9 acres, 1 permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, 2 women living on the land.
entries.notes: Continuation of listing from previous page. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', '2 women living on the land'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl... children'), and Boy children ('boy children'). entries.description: A 5-acre desert homestead run by two lesbian lovers who have lived rurally for 10 years, raising their own food, milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees without TV or media. They welcome visits from lesbians and girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. We are lovers who have lived rurally for the past 10 years. We grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees. We live simply and happily, without TV and media, in beautiful desert country with big skies filled with stars. We enjoy visits from lesbians who have an appreciation of rural life and physical work, who are making an effort to eradicate their racist, classist, ageist, anti-Semitic conditioning. We are ethnic women. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, desert land with much vegetation and trees, women working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('lovers', '2 lesbians', 'women working the land'). Land state CA inferred from contact state and 'desert country'. PO Box means land street/city/zip left blank. num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians' and 'women working the land'. Focus is Farming/self-sufficiency ('grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('visits from lesbians') and Girl children ('We welcome: girl children'). Mentions being 'ethnic women' and visitors unlearning conditioning, but does not explicitly center women of color under codebook definition.

entries.description: A farm run by two lesbians raising bees and honey, Bashkir Curly horses, donkeys, poultry, waterfowl, and exotic birds, and selling mail-order goods. They welcome correspondence from ranching women but have no visitor facilities.
entries.raw_text: BEE SONG HONEY FARMS Rt 1 Box 174, Montague, CA 96064. Raise and sell bees and honey, provide pollination services, make and sell beekeeping equipment. Also breed, raise and train Bashkir Curly horses and standardbred donkeys, plus breed and raise a wide variety of poultry, waterfowl and exotics, including peafowl, rare pheasants and emus. Make and sell mail order t-shirts, caps and rubber stamps relating to bees, donkeys, mules, etc, as well as a line of women's designs. Welcome correspondence from other ranching women; no visitor facilities at present. We have/are: 2 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land address per codebook. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Focus is Farming/self-sufficiency ('Raise and sell bees and honey... breed, raise and train... poultry...'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women based on directory context ('ranching women', '2 lesbians'). No visitor facilities.

entries.description: An inactive group on 23 rural acres on the central Oregon coast with primitive cabins, electricity, and camping space, maintained by one resident lesbian. Offers work trades and space sharing, and welcomes new members/residents as well as supervised girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA c/o CK, PO Box 44, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Inactive group with 23 acres plus some primitive cabins. Many skills to share. Very rural, very private, many camping spaces, and trees. Appreciate work trades for space sharing. Come share and experience the mild central Oregon coast climate, help realize your dreams and mine. Call Carol before 5 am or between 5-8:30 pm. Bon Voyage. I welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children under control, dogs under 100% control. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 23 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, lots of camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space following explicit codebook example ('Who Farm Inc, Penthesileia Inc, Hardscrabble Hill Center') and emphasis on visitor space sharing ('Come share and experience... Bon Voyage'); could also be considered Intentional Community/Cooperative as 1 resident actively seeks new members/residents to revive an inactive group. Land state OR from contact address and 'central Oregon coast'. PO box means land street/city/zip left blank. num_residents is 1 ('1 lesbian', 'women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Girl children ('girl... children under control'), and Boy children ('boy children under control').

entries.description: A 150-acre land trust in Days Creek, Oregon, providing women access to land, currently seeking women to live and work on the land and fundraising to pay their mortgage under foreclosure threat. They welcome new members/residents, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children upon agreement.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470 (Located in Days Creek, OR ). OWLT is open Women's Land dedicated to provide women access to land, especially those women who would otherwise be denied. We are funded by contributions from women around the country. We have a newsletter that is sent quarterly, with an active mailing list of 250 women. At present, we are looking for women to live and work on the land. We are currently raising funds to pay the remaining mortgage, as the former owners (mortgage holders) are threatening us with monthly foreclosure. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children upon agreement, nonlesbian women, dogs. We have: 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust ('Land Trust' in name and explicit trust structure). Land city and state Days Creek, OR from '(Located in Days Creek, OR )'. num_residents left blank because no count is provided ('women living on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children ('boy children upon agreement').

entries.description: A women's community of 6 lesbians on 50 acres 13 miles west of Roseburg, Oregon, practicing consensus decision-making, goddess identification, and land preservation. They welcome girl children, teens, and older lesbians.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END 886 Raven Ln, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649 (13 miles west of Roseburg). We relate independently of one another - we come together for processing big decisions. We all love living in the country in the safety of women's land. We are dedicated to mother nature and are into goddess identification. We preserve the land as wild as much as possible. We love trees and plant often to make up for patriarchal cutting. We bless the land and so appreciate her cradling us. Nature is our best reflection. We welcome: girl children, teens and older lesbians. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Street address is the land address. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative (6 lesbians living and working on the land with cooperative decision-making: 'come together for processing big decisions'). num_residents is 6 ('6 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). Focuses: Spirituality/ritual ('dedicated to mother nature and are into goddess identification', 'bless the land'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('preserve the land as wild as much as possible', 'plant often to make up for patriarchal cutting'), and Older women ('welcome... older lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Girl children ('girl children').

We welcome: new residents (possibly), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, 2 resident structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space ($3/day, 1 week limit), woods, women living and working on the land.

entries.description: A 7-acre homestead with solar power in Sunny Valley, Oregon, lived on by two lesbians aged 57 and 60 with interests in photography, ecology, and alternative technology. They welcome short or long visits from women of all ages, new residents, girl children, daytime nonaggressive boy children, and non-lesbian women, with a strict rule against drugs, dope, and guns.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mtn Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. We are 57 & 60 years old with strong interests in photography, ecology and alternative technology. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. We welcome: new residents, girl children, nonaggressive boy children for daytime visits, not overnight, nonlesbian women, dogs (on leash or in car). No guns, drugs, or dope. Smoking limited to outdoor gravel area. We ask $4/day/woman. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, solar batteries, camping space, woods, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Trail address is the land address. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'women living on the land', owned and lived on by two women aged 57 & 60; welcomes visitors for $4/day; 'We welcome: new residents' noted but does not show active collective recruitment). num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'women living on the land'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No guns, drugs, or dope') and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('strong interests in... ecology and alternative technology', 'solar batteries'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children ('nonaggressive boy children for daytime visits, not overnight').

entries.description: A feminist collective of 5 to 8 lesbians living on 23 forested acres in southern Oregon with women-built cabins and camping spaces. They offer short visits and welcome girl children, young boy children under 8, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE PO Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. WomanShare is a feminist collective of 5-8 lesbians living on forested land in southern Oregon. We have a main house and several women-built cabins and secluded camping spots. The main house has electricity, hot water, and shower. We welcome: girl children, boy children under age 8, nonlesbian women. One-to-four day visits when space is available and we ask $3/day for food and $2-10/day for our land support fund. We have/are: 5-8 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, outdoor toilet, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('feminist collective of 5-8 lesbians living on forested land'). Land state OR from 'southern Oregon'. PO box means land street/city/zip left blank. num_residents is 5 (smaller number of range 5-8 stored per codebook). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children ('boy children under age 8').
